name: Alethia Geospatial Telemetry & Orthographic Earth Projections
description: Scientific geospatial HUD and restrained 3D orthographic Earth projection. Features Great-Circle trigonometric wireframe coordinates, elevation counters, solar terminator lighting, and latitude/longitude spatial markers without noisy neon clutter.
designPhilosophy: Empirical elegance in planetary representation. Rather than cartoonish spinning spheres or heavy satellite rasters, the Alethia approach renders Earth as an architectural coordinate system: mathematical meridians, honest elevation scales, and precision geospatial telemetry that honors the quiet magnitude of planetary science.
appropriateUseCases: Climate science research institutes and environmental initiatives
Geospatial data platforms and satellite telemetry dashboards
Exploration monographs, documentary showcases, and expedition journals
Sustainable architectural planning and site-specific land art projects
implementationApproach: 1. Orthographic Wireframe Canvas: Mathematical projection of 24 meridians and 12 parallels using spherical trigonometry (x = R * cos(lat) * sin(lon), y = R * sin(lat)) rendered with sub-pixel 0.5px line width. 2. Geospatial Telemetry HUD: Real-time latitude/longitude readouts with smooth coordinate interpolation during user orbit. 3. Solar Terminator Line: Soft cosine shading calculating the day/night boundary without heavy post-processing bloom.
performanceConsiderations: Vector sphere vertices pre-computed into static typed arrays (Float32Array) to achieve 60 FPS with zero memory allocations in the render loop.
accessibilityRequirements: Textual alternative providing location coordinates and data metrics in readable tabular form for screen reader accessibility.
